cpo.catalog_note: CARE checks the medicine codes on its terminology server. This step needs internet access. If the device is offline, skip this step.
cpo.credentials_copied: The usernames and passwords are on the clipboard
cpo.credentials_copy_failed: The browser did not allow the copy. Write the passwords down.
cpo.credentials_warning: CARE does not show them again. Give each person their password. They can change it after they sign in.
cpo.demo_intro: The step adds these demo patients. Each patient gets an open visit in {{department}}.
cpo.denied_body: Ask the CARE administrator or the facility admin to do the setup.
cpo.denied_title: Only an administrator can set up the clinic
cpo.done_facility: Open CARE to start work in {{name}}.
cpo.done_no_facility: Make the facility first. Then you can open CARE.
cpo.done_open_steps: You can come back to these steps later
cpo.error_denied: You do not have permission for this step.
cpo.error_network: CARE did not answer. Check the connection, then try again.
cpo.error_rate: Too many requests. Wait one minute, then try again.
cpo.error_session: Your CARE session ended. Sign in to CARE again, then open the clinic setup.
cpo.error_unknown: CARE gave an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again. If the error stays, look at the CARE log.
cpo.facility_exists: The facility {{name}} exists. Apply to add the departments and rooms that are missing.
cpo.field_all_districts: Add each district of the state
cpo.field_local_body_help: Optional. For example, the corporation or panchayat.
cpo.field_locations: Add the rooms of the template
cpo.field_phone_help: Use the international format, for example +91 and the number.
cpo.field_role_organizations_help: Adds one role organisation for each job. CARE shows these groups in the user list.
cpo.field_system_valuesets: Add the missing CARE coded lists
cpo.field_username_help: Letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores. At least 3 characters.
cpo.result_failed_hint: CARE did not change anything. Correct the problem and apply again.
cpo.staff_existing_one: The facility has {{count}} staff member. Add more people below.
cpo.staff_existing_other: The facility has {{count}} staff members. Add more people below.
cpo.staff_password_note: CARE makes an initial password for each new account and shows it once.
cpo.step_catalog_help: Add a starter list of common medicines to the pharmacy.
cpo.step_demo_data_help: Add five demo patients with an open visit, to try CARE. You can remove them later.
cpo.step_facility_help: Make the facility from a template. The template adds the departments and rooms.
cpo.step_organization_help: Select the state and district of the clinic. CARE uses them to find patients and the facility.
cpo.step_questionnaires_help: Add the clinic forms: vitals, consultation note, triage, and pharmacy intake.
cpo.step_roles_help: Add the staff roles. Each role gets the CARE permissions for its job.
cpo.step_staff_help: Add the staff accounts. Each person gets a role in a department.
cpo.step_valuesets_help: Add the coded lists that CARE uses, and the short lists of the clinic.
cpo.subtitle: Each step makes one part of the clinic in CARE. You can apply a step again: it adds only what is missing.
cpo.title: Set up the clinic
